title: Continuous book discovery and knowledge ingestion
goal: MIM should continuously identify, acquire, catalog, ingest, summarize, and retain useful long-form material from lawful sources such as Project Gutenberg and other operator-authorized/public-domain collections across science, literature, philosophy, engineering, language, and human behavior.
success: MIM publishes a durable source registry, acquisition catalog, ingestion batch evidence, summaries/retrieval notes, and explicit blockers/follow-on objectives for failures. At least one approved batch is ingested with verifiable source and summary evidence.
notes: Do not treat download as learning.
Deduplicate by title, author, source identifier, and checksum before ingestion.
Create follow-on objectives for failed conversion, source-access, metadata, duplicate, or indexing blockers.
